en: Illustrated postcard showing a formal garden alley bordered by tall, dense green hedges leading toward a classical pavilion or fountain structure in the distance. Small, finely dressed figures stroll or sit on benches along the path. The style is early‑20th‑century graphic art with clean lines and muted colors. Text at the bottom names the location, and a small artist signature appears on the right of the image.
